app.name: Views Filter & Duplicates
app.short_description: Filter views across 7 fields with ticket description preview and duplicate detection.
app.long_description: Zendesk Support navigation bar app: (1) Filter View: select any active Zendesk view and filter tickets in real time across 7 fields (tag, ticket status, subject/description, requester, custom request date, type, priority) with full ticket description previews; (2) Duplicates: detect and group customers with multiple open tickets with 1-click merge ID copy.
app.installation_instructions: Upload the zip file in Zendesk Admin Center > Apps and integrations > Apps > Zendesk Support apps > Upload private app.
